Description
Strengthen your assets with the inclusion of a 100 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar, from the world’s leading precious refiner, right now! The
PAMP Suisse Mint
of Switzerland is renowned worldwide for its top-notch precious metal refining and assaying. Their Pamp Suisse 100 oz silver bar has been crafted carefully to showcase the finest of Swiss silver that is known for its unparalleled quality and value. This bar contains 99.9% pure silver that has been prepared using a traditional authentic method.
The 100 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar is made of silver and is a highly sought-after bar due to its beautiful, long-lasting finish. These 100 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bars are available for you to buy as premium, cast silver with a beautiful and unique finish. Each bar features smooth round, diamond-cut edges with engraved inscriptions on each side of each bar only There is a nice balance between the heavy feel and matte finish of the silver and the slight amount of shine. It is a great-looking bar that would suit anyone.
The 100 oz PAMP Suisse Cast Silver bars are produced by pouring molten silver into a mold and once the gold is soft, the engraving is imprinted on the bar. The resulting blemished and abnormalities of the casting give each bar character, as well a desirable appearance. Although the casting process doesn’t produce finely finished edges and shapes like mint silver bars,
silver bars
that are produced using cast technology are highly desired due to their rarity of these bars.
With a PAMP Silver Bar, you get an assortment of
precious metals
that are also well renowned for their superior quality. This bar has been certified by the Swiss Government and guarantees one hundred percent authenticity and purity.
Design of Pamp Suisse 100 oz Silver Bar
One of the reasons why the 100 oz PAMP Suisse Silver bar has been considered a collector’s item is its beautiful design and its bullion value. The surface of the silver bar has a frosted finish, which allows for a beautiful presentation.
All of the inscriptions are engraved on the obverse surface of the 100 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar. The obverse side of 100 oz PAMP Suisse Silver bar features a beautiful depiction of the PAMP logo – consisting of words “PAMP” enclosed inside 4 small circular tubes followed by the word “Sussie”. The weight, metal content, and purity of the bars along with the assayer’s mark are also inscribed on the obverse side of the silver bar. On the bottom of each bar in this listing is a unique serial number that consists of a one-letter, six-number configuration.
The reverse side of the 100 oz PAMP Suisse Cast Silver Bar has a smooth surface that is intentionally left blank.
Main Highlights of Pamp 100 oz Silver Bar
Contains 100 troy oz of .999
fine silver
.
PAMP Suisse, the world’s top precious metal refiner, is responsible for its production.
Eligible for
Precious Metal IRAs
.
Each of the silver bars comes in a protective plastic sleeve.
The obverse features the depiction of the PAMP Suisse logo along with purity, weight, assayers stamp, and a unique serial number.
The reverse is left intentionally blank.
Each of the 100 oz PAMP Suisse silver bars is individually serialized.
